findings.title: Finding
sast.SAST-DANGEROUS-EVAL.title: Dynamic code execution
sast.SAST-DANGEROUS-EVAL.evidence: A reference to eval / Function may allow input-driven code execution.
sast.SAST-DANGEROUS-EVAL.remediation: Remove dynamic evaluation; use an allowlist or a safe parser.
sast.SAST-COMMAND-EXEC.title: Command execution API
sast.SAST-COMMAND-EXEC.evidence: A reference to an operating-system command execution API was detected.
sast.SAST-COMMAND-EXEC.remediation: Use argument arrays and allowlists; do not concatenate external input into commands.
sast.SAST-SQL-CONCAT.title: Possible SQL string concatenation
sast.SAST-SQL-CONCAT.evidence: SQL string concatenation or template expansion was detected.
sast.SAST-SECRET.title: Possible embedded secret
sast.SAST-SECRET.evidence: A string matching a key or token format was detected.
sast.SAST-SECRET.remediation: Rotate the secret and move it to a secret store or an environment variable.
sast.SAST-TLS-DISABLED.title: TLS certificate verification disabled
sast.SAST-TLS-DISABLED.evidence: A setting that disables TLS certificate verification was detected.
sast.SAST-TLS-DISABLED.remediation: Enable certificate verification and configure the correct certificate authority.
